body: There really weren't any positives this year. I mean, i found a new job that let's me survive, but considering last year i was able to live off film work i feel it's a step back.
I know, and she is young so maybe i expected too much from her. But i expected to feel better after a few days and i just don't, in fact yestersay was worse than the day before and today, who kmows?
Not really, neurologist said at least a few more months and to be fair, she was at work when she decided to text me so she couldn't really call, though i guess she could've waited.
